title: 观众平均66岁：参与度却增39%，年轻人在哪？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So we've just talked about how golf is for the traditionalists.
segments.zh: 我们刚谈到高尔夫是传统主义者的运动。

segments.en: A lot of people like to say it's the sport most like life because it's hard, but it's also kind of a latest and kind of expensive.
segments.zh: 很多人说它最像人生，因为艰难，但也有些过时且昂贵。

segments.en: Coming from the NFL, do you see those as features to be protected or barriers to growth that should be challenged?
segments.zh: 从NFL过来，你认为这些是应保护的特点，还是应挑战的增长障碍？

segments.en: Well, I think any sport, professional sport that's worth its salt will always sort of challenge where it is. And I think that there's one thing I learned at the NFL over two decades is,
segments.zh: 任何有价值的职业体育都会不断挑战现状。我在NFL二十多年学到的是，

segments.en: you know, if you're not going forward, you're going backwards and innovation matters. So when I first took the job, I was very clear that we're going to honor tradition, but we're not going to be overly bound by it. And you look at some of the trends of the game of golf,
segments.zh: 不进则退，创新很重要。我上任时明确表示，我们尊重传统，但不受其束缚。看看高尔夫的趋势，

segments.en: while, as you say, maybe it has this reputation, or there's elitist.
segments.zh: 虽然如你所说，它可能名声不佳，或有些精英化。

segments.en: If you look at the growth since COVID, participation in golf in this country has grown 39 percent since COVID.
segments.zh: 自疫情以来，美国高尔夫参与度增长了39%。

segments.en: Now, you don't have to play a sport to watch it on television for sure helps.
segments.zh: 当然，不一定要亲自打球才能看电视，这肯定有帮助。

segments.en: Half of that growth is under the age of 25. The average age of a professional tour telecast includes for the majors is 66 years old.
segments.zh: 其中一半增长来自25岁以下人群。职业巡回赛转播（包括大满贯）的平均观众年龄是66岁。

segments.en: So there is a disconnect between where the sport is going and what professionals have been able to do.
segments.zh: 所以，这项运动的发展方向与职业选手的表现之间存在脱节。

segments.en: We are closing that gap in significant ways. And if you just close that gap to a minimum, you've got a bit of a rocket ship.
segments.zh: 我们正在大幅缩小这一差距。即使只将差距缩到最小，也如同坐上火箭。

segments.en: You've talked about how live golf helped expose some of the weaknesses of the tour.
segments.zh: 你提到过，LIV高尔夫帮助暴露了巡回赛的一些弱点。

segments.en: Was the biggest lessons about the economics of professional golf were about the product itself?
segments.zh: 最大的教训是否在于职业高尔夫的经济学，即产品本身？

segments.en: I think it's the product. I think, listen, there's something about the sports industry.
segments.zh: 我认为是产品。听着，体育产业有些特点。

segments.en: I don't understand if you look at the history, huge innovation usually doesn't happen without a crisis.
segments.zh: 我不明白，如果你回顾历史，巨大的创新通常不会在没有危机的情况下发生。
